title: Nourishing Mediterranean Christmas Pudding Trifle
description: A festive and nourishing dessert featuring Christmas pudding, with a Mediterranean twist and a light, aerated texture, served in a bento box.
instructions: Cut the Christmas pudding into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, honey, lemon zest, and orange extract until smooth.
Fold in the whipped cream until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped pistachios and dried cranberries.
To assemble the trifle, place a layer of Christmas pudding cubes in the bottom of a bento box.
Top the pudding with a layer of the yogurt mixture, followed by a layer of the pistachio and cranberry mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of yogurt on top.
Refrigerate the trifle for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional pistachios and cranberries if desired.
